promptContract: Full-bleed low-poly game albedo for one named material; orthographic surface sample; no object, border, text, cast light, highlight, shadow, glow, normal-map color or roughness-map grayscale.

aged-oak.reason: Replace the saturated orange, oversized grain rejected in neutral and frost browser QA with dark low-saturation oak and a tighter grain scale.

black-iron.reason: Replace long parallel bands that read as wood on cages, lanterns, chains, and spike plates with granular non-directional hammered wrought iron after neutral and frost browser QA.

luminous-ward-gold.reason: Reduce the first draft's vivid yellow, baked facet contrast, and thick seams to a restrained champagne albedo with thin mineral veins.

root-bark.reason: Replace mirrored zigzag and bright braided streaks with restrained longitudinal bark ridges after browser QA rejected the first runtime application.

cured-meat.reason: Replace the rejected stone-like mosaic and cream crack network with directional muscle fibers and sparse broken fat seams before rebaking the model-specific PBR channels.

materialPrompts.cured-meat: Full-bleed orthographic low-poly cured dark red meat albedo, broad angular muscle planes, restrained pale fat seams, dry matte surface, no object silhouette, border, text, cast light, highlight, shadow, glow, normal-map colors or roughness-map grayscale.

retention: Original files remain in place; project copies are the stable inputs.
